name: Leaving Soon
description: Surfaces movies and seasons nobody has watched in a while in a collection, then coordinates removal through Sonarr and Radarr.
overview: Leaving Soon scans your Emby library for content that has not been played recently, adds it to a 'Leaving Soon' collection for a configurable grace period, then removes it via Sonarr/Radarr. Supports per-season cleanup for TV, dry-run mode, manual or automatic removal, and favorites/tag exclusions.
